# Synthetic DICOM Part 10 fixtures

`single-frame.dcm` and `multiframe.dcm` are deterministic, anonymized test files generated by `generate-fixtures.mjs`. They contain only synthetic gradients/checkerboards and fixed non-patient UIDs. No clinical or personally identifiable data is present.

Regenerate them with:

```bash
node test/fixtures/dicom/generate-fixtures.mjs
```

The fixture generator and generated files are part of File Viewer under Apache-2.0.

`jpeg-lossless-process-14-sv1.dcm` is a metadata-sanitized copy of
`jpeg_lossless_sel1-8bit.dcm` from `jpeg-lossless-decoder-js@2.1.2`. The pinned
upstream SHA-256 is
`abba54b308ef8f606285b744572ab708b125f33acf726b58530879e0dc4edf42`; the
deterministic import/anonymization procedure is in
`import-jpeg-lossless-fixture.mjs`. It retains transfer syntax
`1.2.840.10008.1.2.4.70` and the original compressed pixel data while replacing
source identifiers with synthetic test values. Copyright and MIT terms are in
`JPEG_LOSSLESS_FIXTURE_LICENSE.md`.

`pydicom-693-explicit-vr-le.dcm`, `pydicom-693-jpeg2000-lossless.dcm`, and
`pydicom-jpegls-lossless.dcm` are deterministic metadata-anonymized fixtures
from `pydicom/pydicom-data` commit
`abc42b90985fb6cf385aa4af766d2c9c94a257a4`. The importer first verifies the
exact upstream SHA-256, then replaces common identifying text fields and UIDs
with fixed synthetic values while preserving transfer syntax and pixel data.
Both upstream and sanitized hashes are pinned in
`import-pydicom-data-fixtures.mjs`; MIT terms are preserved in
`PYDICOM_DATA_FIXTURE_LICENSE.md`.
